newsitem.title: UK: Transdev Plc to buy Lon United for 41.35 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Transdev Plc to buy Lon United for 41.35 mln stg.

text.p: Transdev Plc, the UK subsidiary of Transdev S.A., one of France's top five public transport firms, said on Friday it had agreed to take over London United Busways for 41.35 million stg.
Transdev S.A. is part of the French financial group Caisse des Deports et Consignations.

Transdev said it had already received conditional commitments regarding 70.6 percent of shareholding from London United's directors and three institutional investors, HSBC Equity, 3I and Singer & Friedlander.

Phillippe Segretain, the chairman of Transdev, said: "The proposed acquisition of London United represents a significant opportunity for Transdev to invest in the London bus market. We intend to use the strengths of the London United Group to establish a significant operation in London on which to build a wider UK presence."
